💷 It took Andy Burnham less than a week to rattle the bond market.

The new PM floated "flexibility" in Labour's balanced-budget rules - and gilt yields rose the same day. With the ONS warning debt is close to the annual value of the entire UK economy, there is no room for a Prime Minister thinking out loud. Every basis point lands on mortgages and debt interest that working families pay.

A £2 bus cap and £45 off electricity bills is a press release, not an economic policy.
